text_block_list.text:
Shortly after I was hired at Tracen Academy,
Chairwoman Akikawa 
had asked me show a transfer student around
the academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your cooperation. 
She's the Uma Musume I invited from
America――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――I'm Symboli Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Kris S,
you can go take a look right away. 
Your presence will breathe new life in to
this school.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Invitation, received―― I'm grateful. 
And my mission―― I will complete it without
fail.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm…… that's right.
Engrave your presence and strength 
in to the Turf of this country. Well,
then――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Guidance. ――I'll leave it to you.

Symboli Kris S seemed like the quiet type
but…… being overseas in 
an unfamiliar school could be unsettling too.
That's why――
choice_data_list: I'll try to make the tour fun!

text_block_list.text:
For starters, the training gym,
a point of pride 
of Tracen Academy! Undoubtedly,
the number of specialized 
machines would be a sight to behold!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Looks fulfilling.

Next, was the cafeteria,
universally loved by everyone! 
Just by eating something sweet,
it'll fill you with happiness!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――No. Snacking――is to be avoided.

For large scale events, occasionally, 
the outdoor stage is used……!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: …… ……――wide open.

And what you've been waiting for,
Tracen Academy's pride, the 
training course!
If it's an Uma Musume that loves racing,
they'll definitely love it……!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Turf……――the grass, is really green.

No matter where I took her,
Symboli Kris S remained 
expressionless. I was starting to feel uneasy,
and that's when――

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that Uma Musume…… isn't she the one
from the rumors? 
The one invited from America.

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Uwah,
you're right!
To think the "Emperor" was the one to 
invite her…… that must mean,
she's got amazing abilities, huh?

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you! If you'd like,
do you want to try running? It's open 
now, so it's a good chance to take a look
at the course.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's curious,
you know.
What was it that the 7 crown Uma 
Musume Rudolf-san saw that made her decide
to invite you……?

All the senpai trainers spotted Symboli Kris
S, 
and before I realized it,
we were surrounded……!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
choice_data_list: You can run if you want, I'll wait

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
……――No. 
Guidance―― In progress.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――――Please continue.

I could only nod in response to that―― 
I then ask if she's really okay with that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Up until now―― You've politely guided
me. 
……―― I'll listen―― until the end.

And so we retreated from the gaze of my
senpais. 
For some reason,
we ended up back at the trainers'
offices――
choice_data_list: Was it fine to continue the tour?
Was it fine to continue the tour?

text_block_list.text:
In a place with so many veterans,
if she had shown her strength, 
the chances of being scouted would increase
significantly.

Really?
When I was about to respond with that―― 
I noticed that Symboli Kris S' gaze had
wavered for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――It was…… helpful.

The words that were eventually spoken were
still apathetic. But 
that long pause meant she was 『Searching
for the right words』.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
……――very much so. 
――That's why, please continue.

Very. ――It was very helpful.
Considering how much time she had 
spent considering that modifier,
I believed it was not flattery.

Was it awkwardness, or discipline,
or―― was she just too kind? 
While feeling a sense of warmth,
I continued the tour.

While I was taking a break after the tour
was over―― 
Symboli Rudolf stopped by to ask about
today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
――I see. Even though it was quite sudden,
you still did your best 
to carry it out. I can't thank you enough.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>,
I know it's an unreasonable request but…… 
If you don't mind,
after this would you continue to look after
her?

――Certainly,
she seemed to be a kind but awkward Uma
Musume. 
There would probably be times where she
would be misunderstood.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For better or worse,
she will gather attention. That's why――
choice_data_list: If you're fine with it, leave it to me

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ……I appreciate it.

Symboli Kris S.
She had the abilities to be invited from 
overseas,
and an aura that made it clear she was not
ordinary―― but, probably,
she was still a kind Uma Musume.
choice_data_list: (As a newbie, it has nothing to do...
(As a newbie, it has nothing to do...

text_block_list.text:
She was attracting attention from well known
veteran trainers, 
so the chances of me becoming her trainer
were quite low.
That made me feel a little down.
